id: title:Gilbert09:implement the semantic scholar allen institute for ai import source

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Semantic Scholar as an Alpha warehouse source, requiring an API key and a query, with pagination and resumable ingestion. Tests cover authentication, pagination, and error handling.
review.reason: The chunk implements a Semantic Scholar warehouse ingestion connector, including typed configuration, metadata definitions, REST client execution, and configuration with tests. This establishes a bounded capability for ingesting Semantic Scholar data, though the tier is not established.
review.uncertainty: The tier is not established; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a single, cohesive implementation of a Semantic Scholar data ingestion connector. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed; this is an observation-only pass.
